question: Does any current speech-native/full-duplex candidate provide source-grounded German capability evidence strong enough to remain a production-voice candidate rather than architecture-reference-only?
acceptance_rule: Only explicit current upstream German speech/input/output support with auditable primary-source evidence can keep a candidate in the German production lane. English/Chinese-only or unspecified-German systems remain architecture/reference credit only until German is demonstrated.
outcome: No examined current full-duplex candidate earns German production-voice credit from source evidence alone. DuplexOmni becomes the highest-value German runtime falsifier because its Qwen3-Omni base explicitly supports German speech input/output, while DuplexOmni itself lacks German full-duplex validation.
